TeacherWorkspace.title: TeacherWorkspace
TeacherWorkspace.description: Stores a teacher's active classroom roster selection and game configuration preferences synced to their Google account.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher who owns this workspace.

activeRosterId.description: ID of the currently active ClassRoster document.

soundEnabled.description: Whether classroom sound effects and audio are enabled.

voiceReadingEnabled.description: Whether Vietnamese speech synthesis is enabled.

catchProbability.description: Probability percentage (0-100) of catching a student.

nearMissProbability.description: Probability percentage (0-100) of a near miss.

falseSignalProbability.description: Probability percentage (0-100) of a false signal.

noRepeatInCycle.description: Whether students cannot be called twice in the same cycle.

maxConsecutiveMisses.description: Maximum consecutive misses before forcing a catch (1-10).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last updated.

ClassRosterDoc.title: ClassRosterDoc
ClassRosterDoc.description: Stores a classroom student list and current cycle status owned by a teacher.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher who owns this class roster.

rosterId.description: Unique identifier of the roster document.

name.description: Name of the class (e.g., Lớp 3A - Vũ Trụ Nhí).

studentNames.description: Bounded list (max 100) of student full names in the class.

calledStudentNames.description: Bounded list (max 100) of student names already called in the current cycle.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the roster was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the roster was last updated.

CallHistoryDoc.title: CallHistoryDoc
CallHistoryDoc.description: Immutable record of a student selected by the UFO during a classroom session.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher who owns this history entry.

historyId.description: Unique identifier of the history entry.

studentName.description: Full Vietnamese name of the chosen student.

className.description: Class name at the time of selection.

cycleNumber.description: Cycle number when the student was called.

calledAtIso.description: ISO timestamp string for display and CSV export.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the history record was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-teacher workspace settings and active roster reference.

/rosters/{rosterId}.description: Teacher-owned classroom student rosters and cycle status.

/callHistory/{historyId}.description: Teacher-owned UFO student call history records.
